entities.name: Farid
entities.description: A young Tomakul soldier and Fallaji brasscap who fought for Mishra, more focused on survival than victory.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Leader on whose side Farid fought.

entities.name: Karrak
entities.description: Fellow soldier who traded with Argivians alongside Farid.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Creator of transmogrants, which Farid hated.

entities.name: Transmogrants
entities.description: Ashnod's creations, seen by Farid as desecrations of fallen soldiers.

entities.name: Argivians
entities.description: Enemy force Farid secretly traded with.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Maker of the Clay Soldiers sent to the Argivian front.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: City outside which Farid's trench lay.

events.summary: Farid joins D Company of the Third Tomakul Spears and serves on the Mardun front.
events.quote: He joined D Company of the Third Tomakul Spears

events.summary: After the Argivian counterattack, Farid's unit retreats to within ten miles of Tomakul.
events.quote: his unit retreated to within ten miles of Tomakul in the winter of 44 AR

events.summary: Farid and Karrak secretly trade with the Argivians under the guise of night patrols.
events.quote: conducted trade with the Argivians under the guise of night patrols

events.summary: Farid warns the Argivians of a coming offensive; they withdraw, and the Fallaji take the trench without a fight.
events.quote: The Fallaji force seized the Argivian trench without issue

relations.quote: fought on the side of Mishra in the Brothers' War
he and his fellow soldier Karrak
He had a deep hatred for Ashnod
